headline: Bucharest Stock Exchange Records Increase of Nearly 19 Billion Lei in Capitalization in a Single Week
summary: The Bucharest Stock Exchange gained over 18.66 billion lei in market capitalization this week, up 2.69%. Share transaction value fell 39.18%, or 178.96 million lei.
why: The Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB) is Romania's main equity market, and its benchmark indices track the country's largest listed companies.
